{{Top|leg}}
'''Red seven, blue twelve, green zero zero''' was the universal passcode for the [[Zorp House]] apartment tower in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] had the [[Zorp House building manager|building manager]] of the tower recite the code so they could enter [[Lumiya]]'s [[Apartment three hundred seven twelve|apartment]] during their investigation into [[Tresina Lobi]]'s [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza|death]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
